svg.aria-label: Precision-against-oracle by recall, one dot per cell, per language
svg.title: Precision-against-oracle by recall, one dot per cell, per language
svg.text: One dot per cell: precision-against-oracle (y, a lower bound) against recall (x), never pooled
Filled blue dot = Hobbes; hollow orange square = CodeGraphContext (·cgc), hollow orange diamond = repowise (·rw) — third-party graphs graded by the same key (ADR-101).
Hover a dot for its miss classes with counts. Language is the panel, not a colour; the y axis of each panel starts where its lowest cell sits and says so.
recall, % of in-repo oracle pairs at the cell's roots

svg.text: We draw nothing the compiler contradicts; here is how much we do not draw, and what it is.
Recall across Hobbes' compiler-graded cells runs 23.5–100.0% — a range, never an average: each cell's denominator is its own roots or its resolved sites (C-62).
The misses are one register entry, C-58: closures, interface dispatch, function values, macro and derive bodies; docs/oracle-misses.md has the tables.
Precision-against-oracle is a lower bound (contradictions mostly triage to the oracle's grain, A-8). Trace cells confirm and never contradict, so they sit in their own panel.
